nodes.name: Slack Gateway Webhook
nodes.notes: Deliberately unauthenticated, and deliberately holding no credential. The caller's own Authorization header is forwarded downstream, so the orchestrator remains the single authenticator and n8n never stores the shared secret. n8n is published on 127.0.0.1 only. Ignore Bots stays OFF: the caller is python-httpx, and user-agent bot filters can classify HTTP-library agents as bots and drop the request.

nodes.name: Create Director Task
nodes.notes: Pass-through relay, not a normalizer. slack_bot._forward already builds the canonical SlackIntake (source_event_id, channel_id, thread_ts, user_id, text, allocation_profile, primary_required_capabilities, permalink, received_at), HMAC-signs it, and posts it here. The body is forwarded unchanged: SlackIntake sets extra='forbid', and approvals._slack_intake_attestation_payload signs intake.model_dump(mode='json'), so adding, dropping or regenerating any field breaks validation, the signature, or both. allocation_profile and primary_required_capabilities are owner-set deployment configuration and must never be injected here. The three X-Director-Intake-* headers are unused while ALLOW_PAID_RUNS is false, when the handler falls back to BEARER_DRY_RUN, and required the moment it is true. source_event_id is the idempotency key: re-delivery creates no second task.

nodes.name: Accepted
nodes.notes: The orchestrator's TaskRecord is returned verbatim. slack_bot._intake_receipt_task_id requires one task_id matching DIR-(?:LG-)?[A-F0-9]+ at the top level or under data, and _forward additionally requires HTTP 202 exactly. A summarised or renamed body makes the bot post 'DIRECTOR - BLOCKED' on an intake that actually succeeded.

nodes.name: Intake Failed
nodes.notes: Without this branch a downstream failure leaves the execution with no Respond node, and the webhook answers 200 with an empty body. The Slack bot passes raise_for_status on a 200, then fails the 202 check and reports BLOCKED with no diagnosis. Only the upstream status code is echoed; no response body, provider output or secret-shaped value is relayed.
